decisive_passage: 8.1 Before Contractor makes each progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver to Contractor Subcontractor's own conditional waiver and release on progress payment, on the statutory form set out in California Civil Code Section 8132, covering the amount of that payment. 8.2 After Subcontractor receives each progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver to Contractor Subcontractor's own unconditional waiver and release on progress payment, on the statutory form set out in California Civil Code Section 8134, covering the amount actually received.
